title: TNPSC Group I Prelims PYQs — all available years
definition: Full original-numbered 200-position English adapted study text exists for 2011, 2017, 2019, 2021, 2022, 2024, 2025 and 2026. Original booklet and final-key verification varies: these are NOT certified verbatim bilingual transcriptions and most questions in other years remain ungraded. The 2015 typed Group I historical year remains partial. Official source PDFs for five older years are unresolved. Scores are shown only where separately verified final keys have been aligned to original options.

entries.note: 2026 has 200 user-supplied source-numbered study texts; official answer-key mapping pending.

All Q1–Q200 are present as English editorial study MCQs with A–D options and E=Answer not known. The 27 MB official TNPSC specimen has NOT been independently proofread page by page; source-numbering and options were checked against a bilingual secondary text index. Q200 four-cube views were independently reconstructed from two indexed sources, but original figure certification remains pending. Q199 option D corrected to 481 from compressed booklet/independent reader; official final key marks ALL. No 2025 automatic grades.

Q1–Q200 original-numbered 2024 English editorial adaptations, with A–D options and E=Answer not known. Corrected coaching-site reordering at Q20–25 and Q58–60 using TNPSC scanned booklet; official visual checks are sampled only, not all 200. Independent correctly-numbered English text source linked. Official key exceptions: ALL Q5/32/60/124/133/171, multiple choices Q11/15/24/89/190. Tamil and exact-source proofreading pending. Grading disabled.

Full Q1–Q200 original-numbered 2022 Group I English adapted study MCQs, not verbatim original text. A–D choices and source PDF page links; Q54/Q152/Q153 are labelled figure-to-text adaptations, Q129 has a condensed passage, and final-key exception positions await series crosswalk. Official VERSION A final key is linked but automatic scoring for booklet β is disabled.

200/200 source-numbered 2021 English editorial study MCQs, A–D adapted options; E Answer not known by player. Q51–200 reviewed against secondary numbered Appolo Study Centre bilingual 2021 study PDF pp17–69 (not the primary 32MB TNPSC original booklet). Q182 malformed algebra parentheses, Q184–185 fraction layout reconstruction, Q191 overlapping recharge options, Q193 missing IV in secondary English but IV present in Tamil (important bilingual mismatch). All questions remain ungraded; coaching red answer marks are NOT the TNPSC official final key. Authoritative original booklet and official final Version D option-series mapping must be independently verified.

2019 GR1P Q1–Q200 original-numbered English editorial adapted text, four A–D options, source scanned-PDF pages 3–77. Q1–50: 19 sampled visual and 31 readable-text checks; Q51–200: all 150 visually reviewed from bilingual scanned mirror. Source contains handwritten ticks, NOT the official final key. Official TNPSC key provides Version A/B/C/D; A exceptions tagged only provisionally since booklet/version crosswalk unverified. 0 auto-scored; not certified verbatim English or Tamil.

All 200 original-numbered source-page-checked 2017 English editorial study questions. Official TNPSC Version A final key is linked and series alignment independently verified against source alternative content and ALL decisions on Q94/Q118. 189 / 200 questions receive verified provisional study grades; 11 official ALL/source-disputed questions remain ungraded rather than misleadingly scored. Adapted wording is not certified verbatim bilingual original.

TNPSC Group I GS0811 ω 2015: 104/200 source-numbered English editorial study adaptations playable. 98 originally numbered questions and choice orders were visually checked against TNPSC source scans; 92 are source-key matched and eligible for indicative typed marks, 12 remain ungraded. Q38–43 remain secondary-only pending original image, Q21/Q22/Q26/Q84 have historical source disputes, and official Q59/Q92 ALL are ungraded. Pages for Q74–79/Q85–87 repeatedly failed in current source; Q114–Q200 still untranscribed; total 96 typed gaps. Separate original PDF 200-response practice retains 197 indicative final-key mapped marks positions.
